items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: Toots played piano with me after my brother went in service.

ctx.x: He worked with me also here at the Molen Rouge. I had him with me at one time. Oh, really? I had Manuel Krustow playing trumpet with me at one time. With Jack Lamont on clarinet. I had Hilde on trumpet with me at one time. As a matter of fact, I kept a good group of- Toots played piano with me after my brother went in service. Little Daddy played piano with me for a while there.
What was Little Daddy's brother's name? Which Little Daddy is this?
